records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Sales to Russia and Belarus represented less than 1% of consolidated net sales and less than 2% of Europe, Middle East and Africa net sales for the year ended December 31, 2021.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Governments across the world have taken actions during the first quarter of 2022, including stay-at-home orders, to limit the spread of COVID-19.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: During the first quarter of 2022, we continued to experience disruption in the supply of raw materials and component parts, as well as price inflation and inefficiencies as a result of supply chain issues.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The organic sales increase was primarily due to the impact of higher selling prices across all regions, partly offset by volume declines resulting from continued supply chain constraints; and

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities during the three months ended March 31, 2022 was $10.1 million, driven primarily by inflows from net income, by adding back non-cash items of $13.8 million, a decrease in accounts receivable of $10.1 million and an increase in accounts payable of $2.0 million.
